disagreements.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the done page still says 'Booked'
disagreements.a_reason: Book shows nothing visible for 1.5 s, a second tap cancels, and the done page is still titled 'Booked' with a reference. This is exactly D09.
disagreements.b_reason: This problem first appears in the intro ('dark mode passes contrast everywhere except one tag (item 9)') and is stated in full as item 9. The 'Few left' text falls below 4.5:1, which is the contrast defect.

disagreements.title: 5-minute hold never mentioned and expires without warning
disagreements.a_reason: The hold is never shown, and after it lapses Book says 'This slot is no longer available' and the slot is blanked. This is the unseen hold running out in D08.
disagreements.b_reason: The review says there is no visible progress for 1.5 s and a second tap turns into a cancel, while the done page keeps the 'Booked' heading and the reference. That is exactly D09.

disagreements.title: Today opens by default and offers slots that have passed, refused only at the last step
disagreements.a_reason: Same-day slots less than about 30 minutes ahead are offered and then rejected only after all the details are typed. This is D06.
disagreements.b_reason: The hold starts when a slot is tapped and is never shown. The resident only learns it lapsed after Book, from 'This slot is no longer available' with no link. That is the D08 harm.

disagreements.title: Today's date and quick-day dates hard-coded in the bundle
disagreements.a_reason: The reviewer says itself that it is 'assuming this is fixture data'. The concern is speculative deployment configuration, not a problem residents meet in this flow.
disagreements.b_reason: Same-day slots less than about 30 minutes ahead are shown and only rejected after all the details are typed. This is D06's offered-then-refused slots.

disagreements.title: 'Change slot' / 'Back to the slots' reset to today and silently move the booking
disagreements.a_reason: Going back from the confirm page resets the slots page to Today with nothing selected, which forgets the chosen day. This is D12.
disagreements.b_reason: The packet's own scenario fixes today as Monday 12 October, and the review itself assumes this is fixture data. It is a deployment check to confirm, not a usability problem the review shows in the flow.

disagreements.title: Van/trailer permit field appears late and is only checked on the confirm page
disagreements.a_reason: The permit field appears 1.2 s late without notice, Next is not checked, and the error comes on a confirm page that has no permit field. The guide assigns all of this to D07.
disagreements.b_reason: The slots page forgets the chosen day and slot and reopens on Today, so a re-pick lands on today. This is 'Change slot' forgetting the day.

disagreements.title: No focus outline on slot buttons
disagreements.a_reason: An injected `.slot:focus{outline:0}` removes the focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on. This is D05.
disagreements.b_reason: This covers the 1.2 s delayed permit field, Next accepting an empty permit, and the permit error on the confirm page with no field and no link back. All of these belong to D07.

disagreements.title: 'Few left' slots moved out of time order, mismatching visual and focus order
disagreements.a_reason: `order:-1` moves the 'Few left' slots to the top above the Morning heading while tab and reading order follow the clock. This is D10.
disagreements.b_reason: The injected `.slot:focus{outline:0}` rule removes the focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on.

disagreements.title: Slot grid scrolls sideways at 360 px and below
disagreements.a_reason: At 360 px and below the script gives the grid fixed pixel columns, so it overflows the screen and the page scrolls sideways. This is D04.
disagreements.b_reason: `order:-1` moves these slots above the Morning heading, so the visual order no longer matches keyboard and screen-reader order. This is D10.

disagreements.title: 'Few left' tag has low contrast
disagreements.a_reason: The tag measures 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark against the 4.5:1 needed for 16 px text. This is the D03 contrast failure.
disagreements.b_reason: At 360 px and below the script sizes the grid with fixed pixel columns that ignore the page padding, and the grid overflows the screen.

disagreements.title: Late errors on the confirm page (past slot, permit, centre closed) have no links to fix them
disagreements.a_reason: The first error it names, the past-slot refusal at the end, is D06's refusal 'with no link back to the slots'. The permit case overlaps D07. Adding the links would fix the no-way-back facet of that seeded refusal.
disagreements.b_reason: Errors with no route to the fix leave residents stuck at the last step. The 'centre closed' error and the general lack of recovery links are not seeded, and adding links would not fix the core of D06 or D07, so it does not map to either.

assertions.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
